integrity_note: Two exhaustive and mathematically bijective, separately implemented enumerators agree. All executable source and explicit witnesses are embedded. Published total sequence count is cited rather than claimed as a new result.
limitations: Exact computer-assisted finite census restricted to ternary order-five adjacency-hopping cycles, modulo rotation. No universal generalization, physical-system guarantee, or independence certification. An unindexed published equivalent remains a priority risk.
title: Exact cyclic color-discrepancy spectrum of ternary order-five adjacency-hopping de Bruijn cycles
